ios.desc:
Get ready for the ultimate test of speed and skill in Hill Runner! Follow Joey, on a quest to conquer the never-ending hill. But watch out, bombs are rolling down the hill and threaten to explode Joey at any moment. Use your lightning-fast reflexes as you leap over plummeting bombs, with the difficulty increasing as you advance. Don't let a single slip-up end your game prematurely - use a revive to pick up right where you left off and push for an even higher score!

LEADERBOARDS
Are you ready to dominate the competition? Take on players from around the globe and prove your worth by climbing to the top of the world leaderboards.
